test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
To join in a bank, there are few selection criteria. Read the given conditions and select your answer for the following situation.

**Conditions:**

1. Candidate must be a graduate with 60% marks.

2. Candidate must secure minimum 70% marks in the selection test.

3. Candidate should have a c

options.text: His case will be referred to the GM.

solution:
**Explanation:**

With the given situation of 70% in selection test and 75% in B.tech, Vijay fulfills the first two conditions i.e. 

 
• Candidate must be a graduate with 60% marks and Vijay scored 75% --- **Condition fulfilled.**
 
• Candidate must secure minimum 70% marks in the selection test and Vijay secured 70% --- Condition fulfilled.
 
• Candidate should have a certificate in computer fundamentals but Vijay does not have any certificate which --- **does not fulfill the conditions.** 

​

**Considering the Special Exemptions :**

 
• In case the graduation is in B.Tech, the 3rd condition can be waived off, since Vijay is a B.tech graduate the 3rd condition is waived off.

Hence, the correct answer is **"He will be selected".**
